title: Distributed-system invariants
summary: Check concurrency and delivery invariants: idempotency, ordering, leases and fencing, cancellation, restart recovery and check-then-act races.

provenance.notes: Uses the invariants this runtime already depends on: run-once and zombie protection, lease plus fencing, bounded retries and rollback.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: The multi-step or concurrent flow under review.

outputs.name: invariants
outputs.description: The invariants the flow must keep, each with the code that enforces it.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Races, replay hazards and recovery gaps.

workflow.step: Write each step's postcondition and the state it leaves if the process dies immediately after it.
workflow.check: Every step has a defined crash outcome.

workflow.step: Find check-then-act sequences; confirm the check and the act share one lock or transaction.
workflow.check: No await or yield separates a check from its act.

workflow.step: Check idempotency: replaying a step with the same key must not repeat the side effect.
Check ownership: leases carry a fencing token, and stale holders are rejected at the write.
workflow.check: A late worker cannot overwrite newer state.

workflow.step: Check cancellation and restart: in-flight work stops, partial effects are rolled back or recorded, and resume does not re-run completed side effects.
workflow.check: Resume is tested from a mid-flight state.

constraints: Do not add a second scheduler or retry loop; extend the existing one.
Assume any step can run twice or never; designs that rely on exactly-once delivery are findings.

examples.title: Claim then run
examples.situation: A worker reads a task's status and then marks it running in a separate statement.
examples.guidance: Two workers can both read pending. Make the claim a single conditional update and test with two concurrent claimants.

verification: Each invariant maps to enforcing code and a test.
Concurrency findings include a concrete interleaving.

task.text: Look for a race condition and idempotency problem with duplicate delivery in the worker claim.
Design lease and fencing with restart recovery and cancellation.
